profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at TeraRecon, Inc.
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer at TeraRecon, where I've led our team's shift toward AI-assisted development from documentation, to planning, and the actual implementation.

I've been recognized by leadership as an early adopter for leveraging AI to reshape how our team builds software — setting up MCP servers for live debugging and designing multi-agent, spec-driven workflows that changed how the whole team builds, tests, and ships. My foundation is deep in C# and .NET stack (WPF, WinForms, Blazor, ASP.NET, and .NET Core) and I'm building on it to multiply what a lean team can accomplish with AI.

What doesn't change is how I work: I take ownership, I treat hard problems as a chance to learn, and I go above and beyond to ensure the success of my team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead engineer for TR Detect Viewer, a new AI-driven product for coronary artery disease (CAD-RADS 2.0) stenosis and plaque biomarker analysis tied to government reimbursement, building the CAD-RADS 2.0 workflow on the company’s existing rendering engine, retrieving risk factors/biomarkers from backend, and generating live structured reporting.

- Owned and delivered all Viewer-related releases on schedule for a product now driving $11.5M in sales pipeline as reported in Q2 2026.

- Built an in-application Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes live runtime object values and screen state to AI agents, enabling real-time AI-assisted debugging against the running application without manual deep-diving into large data.

- Designed a spec-driven, human in the middle development workflow that steered agents through an implementation plan, partitioned work across role-separated sub-agents (planner, implementer, tester, reviewer) with scoped context windows, and gated every change behind required unit tests and code review.
Indexed the large legacy codebase as a knowledge graph for agents to query first, cutting token usage and accelerating code navigation during AI-assisted development.

- Recognized by the VP and Senior Director of Applications as the team’s AI adoption leader, codifying these practices and sharing them to help the broader team realize the value of AI in their workflow.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
￫ Played a key role in the development and enhancement of a mature radiology software application, contributing to the implementation of new features and the improvement of existing functionalities using C# and .NET technologies.

￫ Successfully managed multiple concurrent releases, contributing to feature development and defect resolution in both the main and localization releases while assisting other departments in resolving blockers, ensuring department-wide success in meeting deadlines.

￫ Established domain expertise in our medical reporting functionality by leading localization efforts for word and web reports. Supported localization in Word reports by utilizing Visual Basic to process XML data containing localized strings. Localization of web-based medical reports were supported using ASP.NET Razor to retrieve strings sent by the client application and display in a WebBrowser control.

￫ Developed a WPF application that emulated a customer’s PACS software and implemented our in-house API to launch our flagship product in an embedded window. Utilized this application as a foundation to implement customer-requested features and resolve incompatibility issues such as addressing graphical challenges arising from the integration of WinForms within the WPF environment.

￫ Demonstrated an aptitude for problem-solving and resourcefulness, resolving ambiguous customer-reported issues by gathering information to determine their product context and correlating timestamps in our product’s logging functionality to develop a hypothesis of the root cause and ultimately resolve their issue. Resulted in customer retention and strengthened customer relations.
positions.insights: WinForms, Microsoft SQL Server and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
￫ Implemented a solution to manage concurrent read/write operations to I/O boards reducing cost and complexity per machine.

￫ Refactored existing code to shorten time spent expanding/consolidating features, debugging, and porting software to new machines.

￫ Updated codebase from Visual C++ 6.0 to Visual Studio 2019 increasing productivity and quality of life features for other developers.

￫ Cross-functional collaboration with hardware technicians to configure machine handlers end-to-end throughout the product life cycle.

￫ Improved system of storing positional values providing technicians and customers precision tuning to offset hardware imperfections.

￫ Providing customers with excellent technical support for software bugs, custom features, and general machine troubleshooting.

￫ Created a C++ DLL for Exatron machine handler software to communicate with Omron Thermal Controllers via RS-232 protocol.

￫ Integrated SecsGEM interface protocol into machine handlers as an optional addon increasing revenue by up to $30,000 per machine.

positions.title: Security Compliance Intern
positions.description:
￫ Reduced costs imposed by fines by running regular audits across different departments to ensure compliance with NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards.

￫ Stayed current with regularly updated compliance standards set forth by federal regulatory agencies (NERC, FERC, WECC) for consultation across various teams.

￫ Compiled and managed repository for procedures and training documentation per CIP standards.

￫ Communicated cross functionally to assess the needs of different teams to prepare for comprehensive audits.

￫ Established myself as a subject matter expert and presented audit documentation and findings to a broad audience across teams and altitudes.

positions.title: IT Technician / Sales
positions.description:
￫ Contributed to the sales, assembly, and configuration of custom home desktops and enterprise custom servers.

￫ Outstanding customer service given to the client throughout the lifecycle of computer technician related services including (but not limited to) malware removal, OS installations, hardware replacements, and data backups. 

￫ Applied passion and knowledge of the latest technologies to provide consultation for customers and assist with the sales of computer goods and services.

￫ Built relationships and credibility with customers through listening for their needs and combining my passion and knowledge of the latest technologies to provide solutions rather than just products.

projects.title: C# WPF Machine Handler Software
projects.description:
Objective: Developing a new codebase with the C# WPF framework using the MVVM design pattern to reduce the amount of source code maintained and generalizing software to work with various machine handlers.

Technical Features:
- Decoupling the business logic into a DLL library that can be referenced by different UI layers per machine model.

- Improving runtime of various previous position access operations to constant time.

- FindPosition() routines previously called every time a motor was requested to move to a location. New codebase updates positions into a Dictionary with a key of the row and column (ValueTuple).

- Generalizing communication and type of commands for machine handler hardware components.

- Interfacing servo motor commands based on motor model and TCP IP/RS 232 communication protocols.

projects.title: Machine Handler Tester Simulator
projects.description:
Objective: Developing a tester simulator in C# WPF to communicate with existing machine handler software during its autorun routine.

Technical Features:
- Simulator can communicate with the machine handler through RS-232 or TCP IP protocol.

- Ping test diagnostics to check the response time of TCP IP-related machine peripherals.

- Coded an autorun routine to allow the operator to dynamically set testing parameters for full automation of the whole testing cycle. (Simulator will automatically communicate to the machine handler the final test result).
